[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: Fix GAS parseAndProcessTelegramLogs lock stall (temp-disable + false-success fix) + GAS deploy v13
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/475
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1051
  
  Details:
  Diagnosed and resolved the GAS editor error "parseAndProcessTelegramLogs: could not acquire script lock within 30s; aborting to avoid double-processing" — which was silently stranding pending expense submissions. Full session, thread 26845.
  
  ROOT CAUSE (two compounding defects)
  1. parseAndProcessTelegramLogs() acquires LockService.getScriptLock().waitLock(30000) (idempotency guard 1, added 2026-09-09 after the Edgar_20260909124022_298 double-booking). Another execution held the lock >30s, so the run aborted.
  2. FALSE SUCCESS: on lock failure the function did a bare `return;`, but doGet still printed "✅ Telegram logs processed successfully…". So a SKIP was indistinguishable from a COMPLETED run — Edgar's Sidekiq caller never retried, and submissions were silently stranded. Confirmed empirically: a triggered run returned HTTP 200 "✅ …processed successfully" in 19.28s with 0 rows appended; the scored sheet sat at row 218.
  
  WHAT SHIPPED
  - tokenomics PR #475 (merged 054f700): adds `const _DISABLE_PROC_LOCK = true` → the waitLock(30000) acquire is skipped (revert = flip to false); the skip path now returns {status:'skipped_lock_contention'} and doGet returns "⚠️ Skipped…" instead of a false "✅". node --check clean.
  - Downloaded the live GAS project via `clasp clone` — verified live HEAD == repo main for Code.js (byte-identical), so the divergence is only the /exec URL being pinned to deployment v12, not code drift.
  - Pushed to GAS HEAD (clasp push --force, 6 files) and REDEPLOYED THE WIRED DEPLOYMENT IN PLACE: `clasp update-deployment AKfycbwYBlFigS… -V 13` → deployment v12 → v13 at the SAME URL, so Edgar's webhook wiring (telegram_webhook_listener.js:203 etc.) is untouched. Deliberately did NOT create a new deployment (that would mint a new URL and orphan Edgar's config).
  - VERIFIED END-TO-END: one live /exec fire → ✅ in 43s, no lock error; the 3 stuck authorized expenses scored to the offchain ledger (Edgar_20260912162828_478 #4261, …163238_482 #4262, …163341_484 #4263, all "authorized").
  - agentic_ai_context PR #1051 (merged 7e574ff): filed two follow-ups in OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md § Pending — (1) the proc-lock is still TEMP-DISABLED in prod and reintroduces the guard-1 vulnerability class (backstopped only by the weaker lock-free hash guard 2); needs an Executions-page inspection to name the >30s lock-holder before re-enabling; (2) the google_app_scripts/<scriptId>/ repo folder is NOT a clean clasp mirror — a blind repo-folder push would duplicate functions and break the project.
  
  SAFETY NOTES
  - No money moved; no production site promoted. The only ledger writes were the legitimate authorized expense run.
  - Did NOT push from the repo mirror folder (would have injected duplicate files and broken the project) — pushed from an exact live clone instead.
  - Avoided the trap that creating a new deployment would break Edgar's wired webhook URL.
  
  EVIDENCE: tokenomics #475, agentic_ai_context #1051, Code.js lines ~1050-1056, deployment list AKfycbwYBlFigS… @13 (updateTime 2026-09-12T17:33:28Z), scored sheet rows 219-221.
  
  Amount is an estimate of focused session time — adjust if needed.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 300.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
